Event Start

	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif

	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Trn353s'

	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()
EndEvent

Event Refresh
	Grid.SaveSessionState()
EndEvent

Event Grid.Load
	&Update.Link = Trn353.Link(TrnMode.Update, Trn353Id)
	&Delete.Link = Trn353.Link(TrnMode.Delete, Trn353Id)
	Trn353Id.Link = ViewTrn353.Link(Trn353Id, "")
EndEvent

Event 'DoInsert'
	Trn353(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(Trn353Id))
EndEvent

Sub 'PrepareTransaction'
	&TrnContext = new()
	&TrnContext.CallerObject = &Pgmname
	&TrnContext.CallerOnDelete = True
	&TrnContext.CallerURL = &HTTPRequest.ScriptName + !"?" + &HTTPRequest.QueryString
	&TrnContext.TransactionName = !"Trn353"

	&Session.Set(!"TrnContext", &TrnContext.ToXml())
EndSub
